summary: Join our Women in Politics and Governance Training Course to enhance your leadership skills and make a meaningful impact in your community and beyond.
lede: Training in women’s political participation and governance helps women leaders strengthen their role in public decision-making. It is designed for aspiring and current politicians, public-administration leaders, and civil society advocates. Participants develop campaign and advocacy strategies, build coalitions, and practise negotiation and gender-responsive policy and budgeting.
audienceIntro: This program is ideal for women professionals, leaders, and changemakers seeking to strengthen their political and governance capabilities, including:
audience: Aspiring and current female politicians and elected
Women leaders in public administration or local
Gender and governance advisors in development agencies
Women in leadership positions within unions
Anyone passionate about gender equality, leadership
modules: Understanding Women’s Role in Politics and Governance
Personal Action Planning and Way Forward
